summary: evalをcapability suite(低pass率)とregression suite(≈100%)に分離してownerを置き、production failure・bug tracker・support queueから継続的にケースを追加し、複数benchmarkと監査済みsubsetでmodel比較する

evidence.summary: Anthropic: capability evalは低pass率から始め、regression evalは≈100%を維持。「An eval suite is a living artifact that needs ongoing attention and clear ownership」。bug tracker/support queueからeval開始。
OpenAI: SWE-bench Verifiedはtraining exposureと欠陥testでfrontier比較に使えず評価を中止。
OpenAI: SWE-Bench Proも約30% brokenで推奨撤回。監査済みsubsetと複数evalを推奨。

optimize-skill (org-private, reputation unknown): read references/eval-design.md: the Eval set section fixes the case classes (typical success, known failure, edge, near miss, no-op, holdout, at least 20% holdout) and the Eval maintenance section states the conditions under which a case may be added — a new failure class, a case existing ones cannot reproduce, a material production incident, or a new boundary introduced by a model/harness change.

applies_when: Skill・prompt・model選択を継続的に評価する(例: skill eval, model migration判断)
not_applicable_when: evalを持たない小規模用途(先にRMD-F13-001の記録から始める)

expected_effect.primary: evalの陳腐化・飽和を検出し、現在の実務を測るsuiteを維持する

risks: public benchmarkのcontaminationは完全には検証不能
known_failure_modes: saturated benchmarkのfrontier順位への継続利用(local card)
